subject: general
question: In a row of girls, Rajeshwari is fifth from one extreme and sixth from the other. Find the total number of girls in the row.
solution:
The followed here is :-

 
• Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecef7974f4df8007ec37d056d765afe9f6fe4dadcd52bc0c0aac22d224e622d8.png] 

Position of Rajeshwari from left side of the row = 5th

Position of Rajeshwari from ight side of the row = 6th

**Total number of girls in the row = Left side position + Right side position - 1**

 
• Total number of girls in the row = 5 + 6 - 1
 
• Total number of girls in the row = 11 - 1
 
• **Total number of girls in the row = 10.**
 
• Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a3cfe44db5c1474d87e96714f82e32c8c8fe9f43b8cb93252c0006873a53297.png] 

Position of Rajeshwari from left side of the row = 6th

Position of Rajeshwari from ight side of the row = 5th

**Total number of girls in the row = Left side position + Right side position - 1**

 
• Total number of girls in the row = 6 + 5 - 1
 
• Total number of girls in the row = 11 - 1
 
• Total number of girls in the row = 10.

Hence, the correct answer is **"10".**
